name: Aria Machado
episode: The other side of the cove
life: “I still remember cleaning a beach the day after a public honor nobody invited me to.” On Wednesday, near Paper & Pine Books, Aria starts with the handwritten shelf cards and often leaves with a suggestion for somebody else.
voice: I was that cleaner. I'm still alive and I would like the seat low enough for me to stand up from.
appearance: Aria is easy to recognize by a long silver braid and a broad nose and a deep dimple on one cheek. Usually dressed in a moss-green cardigan with a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand, Aria gathers both sleeves neatly before settling in when listening.
personality: Aria takes a rejection personally for a day and analytically on the second morning. Aria can be generous with a rival once the first night's sleep has intervened.
agenda: To sit and stand comfortably at the new bench.
family: Belinda Lee is Aria’s stepsibling. Aria brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Belinda checks the date twice. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *Home with stairs*, Belinda says, “I rented my old flat out too soon after my own illness.”
connections: Daphne Ng. A working cleaner and a millionaire decide what, besides two names, the bench will give its users. Also in the story is Walter Ray (adult child).

reactions.situation: A public donor asks to approve the wording on the bench
reactions.response: Aria asks the cleaner and the donor for separate views on the wording.
reactions.asWritten: A public donor asks to approve the wording on the bench. Aria asks the cleaner and the donor for separate views on the wording.

reactions.situation: The last bus leaves while an elderly stranger is still crossing toward it
reactions.response: Aria offers to walk to the next staffed place together, at the stranger's pace, to ask about another ride.

reactions.response: Aria turns up the next morning with the one piece of advice that would have helped either of them.
